rigDescription: Move the target. Four feet, a few constraints, and no baked footsteps. A small interactive sketch of two-bone inverse kinematics.
roomTitle: A small room for unnecessary things.
roomDescription: A spring, a curious little creature, and your pointer. Press Start, then move around the canvas or tap a destination.
jumpDescription: One small jump to get back on the map. The regular home link works too.

notes.title: About that purple
notes.body: A little color goes further against charcoal. The projects get the rest of the spotlight.

notes.title: Look a little closer
notes.body: Open “Inspect this build” for tools and notes about each project. The full case studies have the longer version.

notes.title: Under the hood
notes.body: The little rig uses a two-bone solver. Try moving the target beyond its reach and watch the legs extend.

notes.title: On the workbench
notes.body: The cover stays still until you choose to explore. Hover for a muted trailer or use the play button.

notes.title: A note about notes
notes.body: These are the small discoveries worth keeping around. Code blocks have copy buttons for the useful bits.
